name: Valheim
description: Valheim dedicated server for co-op Viking survival, with automatic updates and world backups.

ports.name: game
ports.description: Game port; players join with host:port

variables.label: Server name
variables.description: Shown in the in-game server browser.

variables.label: World name
variables.description: Letters, digits, - and _. A new world is generated under this name on first start.

variables.label: Server password
variables.description: At least 5 characters, and it must not appear in the server name — Valheim refuses to start otherwise. Generated when left blank.

variables.label: Skip the update on start
variables.description: Start faster with the installed server instead of checking Steam for an update.

variables.label: Verify game files on start
variables.description: Have SteamCMD check every installed file. Slow; turn it on to repair a broken install.

notes:
Runs on the [DeployKit Valheim image](https://github.com/deploykithq/deploykit-game-images/tree/master/images/valheim). The first start downloads the dedicated server from Steam (~1 GB) and takes several minutes; later starts only download updates.

- Players join with **host:game-port** and the server password.
- Worlds live in `worlds_local/`. To bring an existing world, upload its `.db` and `.fwl` files there and set the world name to match before the first start.
- Valheim has no remote console: the console only answers `/dk status`. Stopping the server sends it SIGINT and gives it almost 2 minutes to save.
- Crossplay (Xbox/Game Pass) is not enabled: it needs a third UDP port.
